paragraphs: Rav Yitzḥak bar Ashyan. Rav Idi bar Avin, in his name, Berakhot (14a), two statements; Ketubbot (27a); Ḥullin (33a, 105a, 121b); Bekhorot (38, end of side b). Rav Hamnuna the Elder said in the name of Rav Yitzḥak bar Ashyan, who cited Rav Huna, Sukkah (42a).
